===Documentation===
To add lore text onto an item's page, add:
<br><br>
'''<nowiki>{{Item Lore | The eternal flame of love, knowing}}</nowiki>'''
<br><br>
After the "notes =" section of the item page to create <span style="background: #7d684640;">[[File:Spellicon_U.png|18px]] <small style="font-size:71%;color: #d8c49c;">'''Item Lore''' : ''The eternal flame of love, knowing&nbsp;&nbsp;''</small></span> [[Category:Lore Items]]
